### Window analysis

Dispatch-to-close ran entirely inside `03:00–10:00Z` (the never-band). Per the
contract both legs queue; monitoring-policy creation is exempted only from AR-3,
not the band. Leg A (monitoring creates + reingest disable + delivery test +
verify) and leg B (probe roll → green-sweep-gated jobfail extension → verify)
are `window-queued`, recorded under `D-P34.4-1`. The re-run prompt is the
contract's own; the verification line is the contract's `alerts.sh --apply all →
--verify → N OK, 0 DRIFT`.

## Design decisions (see ADR-192)

- Definitions live in `ops/monitoring/*.json` in **REST shape minus volatile
  fields** — the same JSON `gcloud monitoring` accepts via `--policy-from-file`,
  so a def can be re-applied verbatim after `{project}` substitution. A `_sig`
  envelope carries kind + match id (or `displayName` for not-yet-created
  policies); `<redacted>` leaf values never compare (the operator's address is
  never committed).
- Verify (`sig-ops monitoring-defs verify`) emits `OK/DRIFT/MISSING/EXTRA` per
  declared resource and exits 1 on any non-OK — the P35.3-probe shape
  (`alerts.sh --verify` = "N OK, 0 DRIFT" over the same engine).
- The jobfail update carries `notificationRateLimit=86400s` — deliverable 5 asks
  for daily re-notification where the policy type supports it; this is the only
  pre-existing policy the mutation list lets us write, so the field lands there
  and is owed for the other three Track-0.5 policies under `D-P34.4-3` (P35.2).
- `alerts.sh` mirrors `protect.sh`: dry-run default, `--apply`, `check`, window
  guard exit 42, pre/post-state capture dirs, read-back verify verbs, stop rules.
- `sig-probe` roll reuses `sig-ops roll-jobs --job sig-probe` (digest-pinned,
  before/after record, `SIG_CODE_COMMIT`); the image is built from
  `git archive HEAD` via `gcloud builds submit`, never `:latest`.

## Test matrix

| test | asserts | dies if |
|---|---|---|
| `test_defs_parse` | every `ops/monitoring/*.json` parses; `_sig` envelope sane | a def is malformed |
| `test_tls_policy_contract` | 21-day threshold, `time_until_ssl_cert_expires`, host filter, daily re-notify | the QA-3 alert is removed/weakened |
| `test_sigalert_policy_contract` | `conditionMatchedLog` on `sig-alerts` + `SIG-ALERT`, rate-limit + autoClose present | QA-4 alert removed |
| `test_jobfail_def_contract` | no `sig-probe` exclusion in the filter; the rolled-0210… policy shape | QA-5/QA-3 jobfail extension regresses |
| `test_existing_defs_mirror_capture` | the four Track-0.5 defs + 2 uptime + channel def mirror the captured live JSON | the codified drift record is lost |
| `test_verify_clean` | fixture live-state == defs → all OK, exit 0 | verify stops converging |
| `test_verify_drift_missing_extra` | edited/missing/undeclared live rows → DRIFT/MISSING/EXTRA, exit 1 | verify goes blind |
| `test_redacted_never_compares` | `<redacted>` leaf matches any live value | the email guard regresses |
| `test_project_substitution` | `{project}` renders the live project id | portability breaks |
| `test_script_check_mode` | `alerts.sh check` prints the plan offline, exit 0 | dry surface breaks |
| `test_script_window_guard` | stubbed clock inside 03:00–10:00Z → exit 42, no mutation | the window rule regresses |
| `test_script_mutation_allowlist` | stubbed gcloud/gh: only the five authorised mutations ever execute | the script grows unlisted writes |
| `test_jobfail_gate` | extension refuses while the latest sweep is red | the contract ordering regresses |
| `test_reingest_schedule_gone` | committed workflow has no `schedule:`; `workflow_dispatch` kept | the cron returns |
| `test_no_email_in_defs` | no `@` address literal under `ops/monitoring/` | an address leaks |
| `test_defs_idempotent_render` | rendered create bodies are stable/valid | apply path breaks |

## Live-vs-queued legs

The run (05:42Z dispatch → closeout) sat wholly inside the `03:00–10:00Z`
never-band → **every mutation queued under `D-P34.4-1`**, nothing ran live:

- **Leg A (queued):** `ops/gcp/alerts.sh --apply all` — prestate → create the
  TLS-expiry + SIG-ALERT policies → `gh workflow disable reingest.yml` →
  `sig-probe` image build + roll → synthetic SIG-ALERT delivery test →
  post-state `--verify`.
- **Leg B (queued, second trigger):** `ops/gcp/alerts.sh --apply jobfail` once
  the re-roll's next scheduled sweep is green — the contract's ordering.
- **Ran live (read-only, in-band legal):** the pre-state capture
  `pre-20261002T060947Z` and `alerts.sh --verify` at 2026-10-02T07:02Z →
  `6 OK, 1 DRIFT (jobfail: the sig-probe exclusion + missing rate-limit),
  2 MISSING (the two new policies), workflow active, probe pinned` — the
  expected pre-leg state; the diff *is* the queued work.
